security_policy.paper_title: Security Guidelines for Implementing Homomorphic Encryption

modulus_semantics.ciphertext_object: check Q against the Table 5.2 q cap
modulus_semantics.evaluation_key_object: check QP against the Table 5.2 q cap because hybrid key-switching objects use the extended modulus
modulus_semantics.final_admission: PASS only when every required object passes

security_policy.admission_caveat: Table 5.2 assumes Gaussian error sigma=3.19; the Lattigo v6.2.0 runtime uses discrete Gaussian sigma=3.2, bound=19.2. The table is used as a conservative admission reference, not as an exact-distribution proof.
